title: Adjustable Rainbow-Striped Backpack Beach Chair  Portable Folding Lounger With Side Storage Pocket And Pillow  Outdoor Beach, Camping, And Leisure Chair
body_html:
Our Rainbow Striped Adjustable Backpack Beach Lounge Chair is your ideal companion for all outdoor leisure moments, crafted to blend stylish appearance with practical functionality for beach, camping, poolside and lawn use.Designed with eye-catching vibrant rainbow stripe fabric, this reclining chair stands out on any seaside or garden scene while delivering long-lasting durability.The high-density oxford cloth is wear-resistant, quick-drying and easy to wipe clean after sandy or wet usage, perfectly adapting to humid coastal environments.

Supported by sturdy lightweight aluminum frame, the foldable structure cuts down storage space significantly, and built-in shoulder straps allow you to carry it like a backpack for effortless outdoor trips.It features multi-position adjustable backrest, letting you switch freely between sitting upright and fully lying flat to suit sunbathing, reading or napping.Equipped with a detachable padded head pillow for extra neck comfort and dual side storage pockets to hold phones, sunglasses, sunscreen and small personal belongings within reach.

Non-slip foot caps enhance stability on sand, grass or pool decks to prevent sliding. Whether you plan a day at the beach, weekend camping or backyard relaxation, this portable lounge chair balances comfort and portability, becoming an essential outdoor furniture pick for travel lovers and family leisure.
